title: adenostyles alpina subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Adenostyles alpina subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean false hawk's beard, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Adenostyles alpina subsp. pyrenaica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
